title: What’s new in Swift
description: Join us for an update on Swift. Discover the latest language advancements, including updates for everyday ergonomics, improved concurrency, and safer high-performance code. Explore workflow and language interoperability improvements and updates in embedded Swift.

let rocket3 = Rocket::SaturnV()    // correctly finds `Rocket::SaturnV`
